title: Unify Quantumoney.app with QuantumoneyAR.app — full sync, professional footer, animated HOME, unified profile, Central Bank, and AR/Map sync

requirements.summary: Update Footer component to show only Quantumoney copyright and HTgamers attribution with social share buttons, removing all Caffeine branding
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays '© 2026 Quantumoney. All rights reserved.' and 'By HTgamers' only.
Share buttons for WhatsApp, X, Telegram, and Instagram are visible and link to correct share URLs.
No mention of Caffeine or caffeine.ai anywhere in the footer.
Footer maintains yellow text/border theme without altering the header or top navigation.

file_operations.description: Replace footer content to display only '© 2026 Quantumoney. All rights reserved.' and 'By HTgamers'. Add share buttons for WhatsApp (https://wa.me/?text=), X/Twitter (https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=), Telegram (https://t.me/share/url?url=), and Instagram (instagram://). Remove all references to Caffeine, caffeine.ai, or external branding. Increase footer padding slightly (e.g., py-6 instead of py-4) and ensure yellow text/border styling is consistent with the existing design system.

requirements.summary: Remove all Caffeine references from index.html meta tags and any other frontend files
acceptanceCriteria: No 'caffeine' string appears in index.html meta, og, or twitter tags.
No 'caffeine' string appears in any frontend source file.

file_operations.description: Search for and remove any occurrences of 'caffeine', 'caffeine.ai', or related strings in meta tags, Open Graph tags, Twitter card tags, and HTML comments. Ensure all metadata references only Quantumoney branding.

requirements.summary: Rebuild HOME page with full animated universe background, growing golden coin animations, welcome message, and Install AR App CTA
acceptanceCriteria: HOME page shows animated space background with stars, planets, comets, and meteorites.
A new golden coin (alternating ICP and QMY) animates from the center of the screen, growing outward, every 5 seconds, lasting 3 seconds each.
A welcome message 'Welcome to the Quantumoney World' is visible on the page.
An 'Install AR App' button is present and opens https://QuantumoneyAR.app in a new tab.
Existing hero sections and feature grid are preserved.

file_operations.description: Extend the existing SpaceBackground component usage to include more pronounced stars, planets, comets, and meteorites. Add a new animated coin component that renders a golden coin (alternating between ICP and QMY using the generated images frontend/public/assets/generated/icp-coin-gold.dim_256x256.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/qmy-coin-gold.dim_256x256.png) that grows from the center of the screen outward over 3 seconds, appearing every 5 seconds. Use CSS transforms (scale) and opacity for the grow-out animation. Add a welcome message 'Welcome to the Quantumoney World' prominently near the top of the hero section. Add a CTA button labeled 'Install AR App' that links to https://QuantumoneyAR.app with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'. Preserve the existing hero content and feature grid. Ensure the animated coins do not interfere with click interactions on other UI elements.

requirements.summary: Upgrade Profile page to unified profile with inline wallet, transactions, vesting, and game stats; remove separate wallet navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Profile page shows player name with inline edit and save.
Profile photo upload component is functional with preview.
ICP and QMY balances are visible on the profile page.
Send and Receive token panels are embedded in the profile wallet tab.
Full transaction history is rendered within the profile page.
Vesting info and welcome bonus card are visible.
XP progress bar and level stats are shown.
No separate wallet page link is required for these features.

file_operations.description: Integrate all wallet functionality directly into the Profile page tabs. In the 'Wallet' tab, embed the SendReceivePanels component (already exists), QMYTransactionHistory component (already exists), VestingBreakdown component (already exists), and WelcomeBonusCard component (already exists). Ensure the profile tab includes editable player name with inline save, ProfilePhotoUpload component for photo upload/preview, ICP and QMY balance displays (fetched using useICPLedger and useQMYLedger hooks). In the 'Game Stats' tab, include ARPlayerStats component (already exists) showing XP progress bar and level. Remove any navigation links to a separate WalletPage. Ensure all empty or placeholder tabs are completed with relevant content. Maintain yellow text/border styling and glass-panel design.

requirements.summary: Rebuild Central Bank page as professional dashboard with tokenomics stats, vesting, burns, supply charts, and download buttons
acceptanceCriteria: Central Bank page renders tokenomics stats, vesting table, burn history table, and supply charts.
Geographic coin/monster distribution visualization is present.
Download buttons for CSV and document exports are functional.
Explanatory accordion section is present and readable.
QMY Ledger canister ID 5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai is used for balance/supply queries.

file_operations.description: Enhance the Central Bank page to display: (1) TokenomicsSection component (already exists) showing total, circulating, locked, vesting, burned supply with percentages; (2) VestingTable and VestingChart components (already exist) for vesting schedule visualization; (3) BurnHistoryTable component (already exists) for deflation history; (4) SupplyChartsSection component (already exists) for time-series supply data; (5) GoldPaperUniverseVisualization component (already exists) for geographic coin/monster distribution; (6) ExplanatorySection component (already exists) for accordion-based transparency info; (7) DownloadButtons component (already exists) for CSV/document exports. Ensure data is fetched from the useLuxuryBankData hook and that the QMY Ledger canister ID 5o54h-giaaa-aaaad-aentq-cai is referenced for balance queries. Maintain professional glass-panel styling with yellow accents.

requirements.summary: Update Map page to sync with Carteira A backend canisters showing coins and monsters at identical coordinates
acceptanceCriteria: MapPage fetches coin and monster markers from the same backend actor used by the AR page.
Markers shown on the map match coordinates stored in the backend.
No visual layout changes to the map beyond data source update.

file_operations.description: Ensure MapPage fetches markers using the useGetMapMarkers hook from frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts, which queries the backend actor for getMapMarkers(). Verify that the Leaflet map renders markers at the exact latitude/longitude coordinates returned by the backend. Ensure no layout or styling changes beyond confirming data synchronization. The backend actor already uses the Carteira A canister configuration from useActor hook.

requirements.summary: Update AR page to request camera permission on load, add lock/unlock and capture action buttons, sync with backend
acceptanceCriteria: Camera permission is requested when the user navigates to /ar.
AR buttons for 'Lock/Unlock QMY' and 'Capture Monster' are visible and functional.
Captured monsters and coin lock state are persisted to the backend.
AR page layout is otherwise unchanged.

file_operations.description: Use the camera component's useCamera hook to request camera permission immediately when the AR page mounts (set autoStart: true in useCamera config). Add two new action buttons in the AR UI: 'Lock/Unlock QMY' and 'Capture Monster'. Wire these buttons to call backend methods (via useActor) to persist the lock state and captured monster data. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing camera integration. Ensure the camera preview has explicit dimensions and is responsive. Minimize other layout changes.

requirements.summary: Maintain yellow text/border design system and slightly increase footer visibility without altering header
acceptanceCriteria: All new and updated components use yellow text and thin yellow borders.
Transparent glass-panel style is maintained across profile, bank, and map pages.
Footer has slightly increased padding/visibility without changing header styling.

file_operations.description: Verify that global CSS custom properties and component classes (e.g., .glass-card, .cta-button) consistently apply yellow text, thin yellow borders, and transparent glass-panel styles. Ensure footer-related classes have adequate padding (e.g., py-6) for increased visibility. Do not alter header or top navigation styling.
Verify that Tailwind custom colors (QMY gold palette) are correctly defined and consistently applied across the project. Ensure no conflicting color or border-radius configurations exist.
